name: std::filesystem::filesystem_error::operator=
intro: Assigns the contents with those of other. If *this and other both have dynamic type std::filesystem::filesystem_error then std::strcmp(what(), other.what()) == 0 after assignment.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
other

 -

 another filesystem_error object to assign with

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Typical implementations store path objects referenced by path1() and path2() in a reference-counted storage. As a result, *this and other usually share their path objects after assignment.
